_doc: No Law, beat 3 (docs/missions/no-law.md; issue #773): Cody (one of the Baron's hired guns; not the red shirt, Kett, who raids Joe's camp that night; the stranger, the Baron's foreman, shot the sheriff: #905, Sean #906) walks into the saloon (saloon B's corner door, #1230) at night already shouting at Earl (Sean, 2026-11-12: as he comes in, not when he reaches the table), kicks his chair out from under him (the card cheat's kick, CardCheat), draws, shoots him in the head where he lies, says there's no law to save him now and walks out. A stranger sits down in the free chair a minute before and tells you not to move; sat at the table you're held there (PlayerSeat.hold) and the game with you (CardGame.interrupt(&"cody", true)). The room goes quiet (the folk hushed, CivilianBrain.hush) till the barman: "Jesus, Cody, my chair!". After: you're let go, Earl's body stays, the drifter and the miner leave, the stranger has his word and goes. Started by ValleyFolk at `hour` on the first night (StoryState has no nolaw.murder yet), or sooner once you've played `after_hands` hands at the table (from `earliest` on); the bridge's `moment no_law_murder` starts it now. `-- --no-murder`: the valley's nights without it. Sean (chat, 2026-11-09): sat at the table with no gun, "so he can't do anything at all"; "the stranger sits there and tells the character not to do anything"; "card cheat shot in the head"; the barman's first words "Jesus, Cody, my chair!".
status: PROPOSED (#773): the timings, lines and stand-in men are this session's; Cody's stand-in is the blacksmith's model (a rough man in a grey-blue work shirt: not the red shirt, #796) until the characters lane makes him.

cody._doc: Comes in from the street by `in` (places of ValleyFolk's), shouting the accusation as he's taken in at its first; the stranger's warning `warn_after_s` after the shout (once he's within `stop_m` of the table, when the game stops). Out by `out` and on `off` [x, z] m from its last down Main Street and on that way, taken out of the world once `gone_m` from you and out of your sight (follow him and he walks on). `after_s` after the stranger's sat (or gave up on a chair).
cody._aim: Where his ball goes: an anatomy structure's middle as Earl lies (config/anatomy.json ids), or "head". Sean, 2026-11-17 (#1057): Earl's down and bleeding, not shot dead: down through the right collarbone (the subclavian), a wound that kills him in a minute or two by the body's own clock, so he's alive when the barkeep sends you to Doc's and dead before you get him there. The body decides; a second ball only if the first missed him.

stranger._doc: Sits in the free chair you're not in (the first of `chairs` free), a minute's quiet before Cody; stands and leaves `leave_s` after Cody's out of the yard.
stranger._approach: The way to each chair from inside the corner door (`saloonb_cards`), [x, z] on saloon B's floor in its space (#1230; the set's `hall`), round the table and its men (#773's playtest: the north chair's way went through the table): the south chair's straight on, the north chair's round the table's east side (the window side has Earl's back and the wall's lamp); walked back the other way when he goes.

hold_why: The stranger's hand is on your arm. Sit still.

after._doc: After Cody's out: who leaves (ValleyFolk.send_off, gone for the night) and how long after (s); the barkeep comes round to Earl `to_body_s` after his first line, says his second there (or `barkeep_more_s` on), gathers the cards and goes back to his bar `watch_s` later.

seen._doc: nolaw.seen_from: table (sat at it), yard (within saw_m, the shot in your view's half), heard (within heard_m), away.

stranger_sit: Evening. Mind if I sit in a while?
stranger_warn: Don't move, friend. Whatever happens next, you sit still.
stranger_word: You didn't see a thing tonight. Nobody did. Remember that.
accuse: Earl, you cheating son of a bitch!
gloat: Ain't no law left in this valley to save you now, Earl.
barkeep_more: Somebody ought to fetch the... hell. Ain't nobody left to fetch.
stranger_aimed: Easy, friend. I ain't the one you want.
Put it up. You'll only get yourself killed.
